capture.title: Organic first-join favorite-color prompt
capture.expectation: The production server-triggered Choose Your Favorite Color modal is opaque and centered; its 4 by 4 color grid, Figure ON control, disabled Done control, text, and figure preview are crisp and unclipped.

capture.title: Favorite color selected state
capture.expectation: The same favorite-color modal visibly marks purple as selected and enables Done without text bleeding, transparency, blur, or layout movement.

capture.title: Favorite color round trip applied
capture.expectation: The real Done action has closed the modal and returned to a normal packaged world view after the server persisted and synchronized the purple World Players figure.

capture.title: Claw machine collection screen
capture.expectation: The Claw Machine Configuration screen shows the real packaged One Piece selection, collection and figure grids, token controls, and footer; labels and controls are not clipped or overlapped.

capture.title: Claw machine settings modal
capture.expectation: The production Settings modal is opaque, centered over the claw-machine screen, and its server tab, sliders, buttons, and labels remain readable without token-button text bleeding through.

capture.title: Drawn box held in first person
capture.expectation: First-person view in daylight holding the One Piece box the regular token just drew: the box model, its collection art and logo, and the figure inside are fully textured and correctly proportioned in the hand; the hotbar shows it selected; no missing (magenta and black) textures, floating parts, or clipping into the camera.

capture.title: Placed box from the front
capture.expectation: The drawn One Piece box stands on the grass seen from the front, HUD hidden: the box, its window, collection art and logo, and the figure inside are fully textured, upright, centered in the box, and correctly lit; no missing textures, z-fighting, or parts poking through the box.

capture.title: Placed box from the side
capture.expectation: The same placed box seen from its side: the side art is textured and the box keeps its proportions; the figure stays inside the box; no missing textures, gaps, or parts poking through.

capture.title: Placed box from above
capture.expectation: The same placed box seen from above at an angle: top and front faces are textured and aligned, the figure is visible and inside the box, and the box sits flush on the grass; no missing textures or floating parts.

capture.title: Claw machine held in first person
capture.expectation: First-person view in daylight holding the claw machine: its cabinet, glass, claw, and base are fully textured and correctly proportioned in the hand, and the hotbar shows it selected; no missing textures or clipping into the camera.

capture.title: Claw machine held in third person
capture.expectation: Third-person front view of the player holding the claw machine, HUD hidden: the player model and the held claw machine are fully textured, the machine sits in the player's hand at a sensible scale and angle, and nothing is missing, floating, or clipping through the player.

capture.title: Adventure Time Collection placed in the world
